name: landing-page-api-domain-subpackages
title: Landing Page API Domain Subpackages
description: Move scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/api from a single flat `package main` into per-domain Go subpackages under `api/domain/<name>/`, one domain at a time, behavior-preserving. The execute round of qa-deep-landing-page-business-suite-screaming-architecture-20260408 deferred all 8 domains because the original plan tried to bundle 4 in one shot, hit cycle/dep risk, and produced no subpackaged domains. This initiative breaks the work into one research item (dep graph + cycle-resolution / shared-package design) plus one execute item per domain (metrics, ai, remote-profile, user-auth, landing, billing, downloads, admin), so each domain extraction is reviewed and queued independently. Health stays top-level.
